The Bearcat roars again. ✈️

After six years of restoration and overhaul, the Commemorative Air Force’s Southern California Wing fired up its Grumman F8F-2P Bearcat at Camarillo Airport on Nov. 14. With Jason Somes in the cockpit, the Pratt & Whitney R-2800 Double Wasp ran for about 10 minutes.

There’s more work ahead before the first test flight. For the crew that spent six years bringing this Bearcat back, ten minutes of radial-engine thunder was a milestone worth hearing.

Sources: Vintage Aviation News, Nov. 19, 2026, and CAF SoCal’s aircraft profile.
